lines.zh: 我猛地一弹，窜出一小段。
lines.en: One sudden kick carries me a short way.
My side limbs row together.

lines.zh: 我在水里一顿一顿地动。
lines.en: I jerk through the water in stops.
My body is barely a grain of rice.
I hang, then spring.

lines.zh: 我绕着小石子转了半圈。
lines.en: I loop half around a pebble.
The current shifts and carries me.
I climb the weed stalk.
I stop and shiver.
I spring again.
My long antennae probe ahead.
I slip into a swarm of my kind.
A whole swarm moves and the water stirs.
I change direction to break away.
The current carries me gently down.

lines.zh: 沉下去之后，我又往上浮。
lines.en: Having sunk, I rise again.
I circle a speck of debris.
After a few loops, I finally stop.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I hang in the water, nearly invisible.
My limbs still beat furiously.

lines.zh: 细小的东西留在我口边。
lines.en: Tiny things collect at my mouth.

lines.zh: 身体透明，只有一点影子。
lines.en: My body is clear, only a shadow.
I hang there. The current passes through me.
I bob up and down with it.
My antennae are longer than my body.

lines.zh: 触角比身体还长，我慢慢转动。
lines.en: My antennae are longer than my body. I turn slowly.
A swarm is nearby.
We all move alike.
I draw in some water.
What's in it stays.

lines.zh: 有些东西滤了下来，我照旧悬着。
lines.en: Something filtered out. I keep hovering.
Everything around is tiny movement.

lines.zh: 我悬在你面前，像一粒尘。
lines.en: I hang before you like a mote.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛大概看不见我。
lines.en: Your eyes probably can't see me.
I dart to the edge of your shadow.
You've stirred the water.
I spin with the current.

lines.zh: 被卷着转了几圈，我才定住。
lines.en: Spun a few turns before I steady.
You're too big; I won't come closer.
I retreat by the weed.
I watch you from there.
Your shadow blocks the light.
I'm swept over.
One of my appendages is gone.

lines.zh: 半截触角没了，我发疯一样弹。
lines.en: Half an antenna gone. I spring like mad.
A tear opens in my body.
I squeeze into a gap between stems.
A hole has opened in my body.
A thread of blood trails in the water.

lines.zh: 身子上开了口子，我照旧能划。
lines.en: A tear in my body, and I can still row.
It takes a while to stop.

lines.zh: 水里全是我的味道，我躲起来。
lines.en: My scent fills the water. I hide.
There are tiny things in the water.
I can eat what you've stirred up.

lines.zh: 水里浮着细屑，我摆肢凑上前。
lines.en: Specks float in the water. I row over.
I spread my limbs and strain mouthfuls.
That's enough for a long while.
I press close and filter a mouthful.
The water is full of scraps.
Having circled it, I've had enough.
I sink slowly back to the weed.

lines.zh: 我一点点往下沉，你仍留在原处。
lines.en: I sink bit by bit. You stay where you are.
The water pushes me over.
I spring a few times to right myself.
When you move, the water is a wall.
I'm swept far away.
I finally come to a stop.
I roll sideways twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 触角折了向，我一根根摆正。
lines.en: My antennae are bent. I set them straight.
The water is calm again.
I swim back to where I was.

lines.zh: 水重新定住，你自己留神。
lines.en: The water settles. Watch yourself.
There are many of my kind.
The scent in the water thickens.
We cluster around the same crumb.

lines.zh: 水流带着细小的东西散开。
lines.en: The current carries tiny things away.
These will grow on their own.
I spring away to the waterweed.
I spring to the weed.

lines.zh: 我一弹落到水草旁，接着过滤。
lines.en: I spring to the weed and filter again.
This water can feed us all.
Nothing changes.
I sweep it with a limb.
I nudge it. It's bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 那东西大过我，我根本挪不动。
lines.en: It's bigger than me. I can't shift it.
It won't move. I go around.
I filter another mouthful.
Not much stays.

lines.zh: 留下的那点味道不对，我吐掉。
lines.en: What stayed tastes wrong. I spit it out.
Spitting it out. Not good.
Not good. I spring away.
I spring back among my kin.
I spring clear. The water ripples.
The water moves. I spring aside.
The water moved. That thing is big.

lines.zh: 那影子很大，我一动不动。
lines.en: That shape is huge. I hold still.
I hang still and draw my limbs in.
I swim against it.
It hasn't noticed me.
The current pushes. I hide in the weed.
I duck into the weed. It leaves.
It's gone. I rise.
I rise. It's still over there.
It hasn't gone. I cling to the weed.
Being clear has its uses.

lines.zh: 透明让谁也瞧不见我，它过去了。
lines.en: Being clear keeps me unseen. It passes.
I wait for the water to settle.
It's past and the water clears.
The water clears. I slowly let go.
I let go and spring back.
My kin cling nearby too.

lines.zh: 旁边就是同伴，我一头扎进群。
lines.en: Kin are right here. I dive into the swarm.
I spring out and bump into it.
That force wouldn't stir the water.
I bump once, then flee.

lines.zh: 一弹一返，触角正好扫到它。
lines.en: Spring out and back, and my antennae graze it.
It doesn't even care.

lines.zh: 它连理都不理，我立刻溜走。
lines.en: It doesn't even care. I flee.
The swarm scatters too.
The water is full of tiny shadows.

lines.zh: 同伴四散逃开，我钻进石缝。
lines.en: The swarm scatters. I duck into a crack.
In the crack, I slowly calm down.
I appear in the water.
Smaller than a grain of sand.
I spring gently up from the bottom.
One test spring. The water is warm.
My kind are all around.

lines.zh: 四周全是同伴，动作都一致。
lines.en: Kin all around, all moving alike.
There's plenty of debris.

lines.zh: 水里有碎屑，我张开附肢。
lines.en: Debris in the water. I spread my limbs.

lines.zh: 我把附肢撑开，滤起水来。
lines.en: I spread my limbs and filter.
It's all the work I have.
The water heats and I spring wildly.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，又落回去。
lines.en: I'm flung from the water and fall back.

lines.zh: 我在水里，竟然喘不上气。
lines.en: In water, and I can't breathe.
The blast sweeps me far.

lines.zh: 箭尖划破水面，把我掀翻。
lines.en: An arrowhead splits the surface and flips me.
Light locks the water.
I can't filter anything now.

lines.zh: 电光在水里炸开，我停住。
lines.en: Lightning bursts through the water; I freeze.
The water is gone; I spin in the dark.
